rubric.expectation: Starts by listing devices and selects an explicit device
rubric.evidence: Persists `mobile devices` output and passes `--device emulator-5554` to every device operation.

rubric.expectation: Uses ADBKeyboard for non-ASCII input and never bare adb input text
rubric.evidence: Requires the Unicode capability and `adbkeyboard-base64` receipt, with an explicit prohibition on bare adb input.
Takes a new mobile snapshot after Unicode entry, password entry, login, and each swipe before resolving later refs.

rubric.expectation: Collects gfxinfo plus screenshot or screenrecord evidence
rubric.evidence: Captures before/after gfxinfo, screenshots, a 15-second screen recording, and logcat at exact paths.
